# Aiman Royale

> Premium ethnic designer wear for women in India. Specialising in sarees, lehengas, anarkali suits, palazzo sets, salwar suits, Indo-westerns, co-ords, gowns, and bridal wear.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://aimanroyale.com/): Main storefront with featured collections and new arrivals
- [All Products](https://aimanroyale.com/products): Complete product catalogue
- [All Collections](https://aimanroyale.com/collections): Browse by collection
- [Book Appointment](https://aimanroyale.com/appointment): Schedule a personal styling appointment
- [About Us](https://aimanroyale.com/about-us): Brand story and values
- [Contact](https://aimanroyale.com/contact-us): Get in touch
